title: Esses unit table (units-1)
description: The unit registry's table: data/units.json (shipped, 02 section 2.3) and the per-user units.user.json. Quantities with their dimension, display family and SI base unit, each with its units in display-list order; a unit converts as value_in_unit = value_in_base * scalar + offset (02 section 2.1). Files never store registry ids, only symbols (02 section 2.2 rule 6). Rules the schema cannot express are checked by UnitRegistry::load: the first quantity of the shipped table is the unitless quantity whose first unit has the empty symbol (unit 0, kNoUnit); the base symbol is one of the quantity's units with scalar 1 and offset 0; deltaFamily names a quantity with isDelta true and the same dimension; quantities sharing a family share dimension and isDelta; no spelling (symbol, alias or display) belongs to two units, exactly, after case folding or after the spelling normaliser, except that a spelling listed in caseSensitive matches exactly only; caseSensitive lists only the unit's own symbol or aliases; a user file may extend a shipped quantity (same name, family, dim, base, isDelta and deltaFamily; units are appended) or add quantities, and may not reuse a shipped spelling. Unknown top-level members are allowed and preserved; quantity and unit records are closed.

$schema.description: Schema id (D-072). The urn:esses: form is written; the bare esses: form of earlier drafts and the later https form are accepted on load and normalised on save (02 section 6.6 rule 1).

schemaVersion.description: Minor version within major 1 (02 section 6.6 rule 1).

aliases.description: Further names UnitRegistry::quantityByName accepts, case-insensitively ("Angular Velocity" for "Angular Speed").

family.description: Display family: distinct for Delta vs Absolute, Torque vs Energy, Angle vs Ratio; conversion across families is refused even when dimensions match.

base.description: Symbol of the SI base unit of this quantity (scalar 1, offset 0).

deltaFamily.description: Name of the delta quantity that a difference of two absolute values of this quantity yields (Temperature -> Temperature Delta).

unit.description: Unit (02 section 2.1). scalar defaults to 1 and offset to 0.

scalar.description: Non-zero; negative for a sign-flipping compatibility unit.

toBase.description: The size of one unit in base units, for factors defined that way (NIST SP 811: 1 in = 0.0254 m); scalar = 1 / toBase. Non-zero; mutually exclusive with scalar.

aliases.description: Case-insensitive import spellings, matched after white-space collapsing and case folding (02 section 2.2 rule 3).

compat.description: Compatibility tag (D-141): a lower-case token naming the analysis software whose units and maths this spelling exists to resolve; the unit is defined from its physical meaning.

caseSensitive.description: Spellings of this unit (its symbol or aliases) that match only exactly, because another unit uses the same letters in a different case ("g" the gram, "G" the acceleration unit).

symbol.description: Canonical ASCII unit key ("km/h", "kPa a", "deg C"): printable ASCII, single inner spaces, no leading or trailing space. The empty symbol is the unitless unit (unit 0, kNoUnit), the base of the first quantity of the shipped table.

note.description: Free text for maintainers (provenance, rationale); ignored by the loader.

dimension.description: Exponents of [L, M, T, I, Theta, N, J]; angle and ratio are dimensionless. -128 is reserved for the unknown dimension (D-085).

legacyBag.description: Fields removed by a migration, kept verbatim (02 section 6.6 rule 3).
